# Assassination Rogue — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Build (levels 10-60), 41/10/0 — no respec, one build from level 10 to 60. The decision loop walks 94 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 51 (1 member), level 60 (9 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/rogue/assassination/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **OK** — 64% of the human spec median (317 vs 497.7 boss DPS over 62 boss fights); 2% hit / 0% crit costs the most here; mix fires [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [assassination.md](./assassination.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **RA00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 242); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).

- **RA01-stealth — Stealth:** The runtime refuses Stealth for every resident in a dungeon party that is not its initiate (Tick.cpp CastRefusal clause 1, `grouped_not_the_opener`), and the initiate is the tank alone (Command.cpp, Registry.cpp: `initiate = role == Tank`), so a grouped rogue is never the opener and the vocabulary has no predicate for it. Round twenty, Sable: 2,489 refusals of RC01-stealth for that reason, the only rule refused for it, and all 262 of them that have a sampled snapshot carried a party.
- **RA03-vanish — Vanish:** HO-TKB-PLAY-174 (PIONEER FIX, observer Hateforge playbook section 1.5, p4-group 456 core-script read L296-L339, vocabulary v35 enemies_engaged_entry): never while Har'gesh Doomcaller (60737) has a Faceless Terror (60738) alive: a Terror with no victim calls the boss EnterEvadeMode every 5 s, which resets him to full health and despawns the Terrors, and an evade by a hunter or rogue leaves the Terror victimless.
- **RA04-cold-blood — Cold Blood:** HO-TKB-PLAY-232 (rotation programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Cold Blood goes on the 5-point Eviscerate, not on the first hit of the fight: "Eviscerate at 5 combo points; Cold Blood on it when ready" (assassination.md L23), "Cold Blood on a 5-point Eviscerate, or on a Noxious Assault when a Seal Fate crit gets you to 5 faster" (L93). The Noxious Assault/Seal Fate branch is not built: no term says a Seal Fate crit is coming.
- **RA04-blade-flurry — Blade Flurry:** At least half of your damage is poison, and poison doesn't transfer" (L118).
- **RA04c-blade-flurry-off — Cancel Blade Flurry:** HO-TKB-PLAY-260: the toggle's other half (RC04c): off when one hostile is left (leveling.md L117, L170) and always from 40 (L118: "leave it off"), so a rogue that crosses 40 with the aura up (it is permanent) drops it. The loop skips a cancel rule while the aura is not up.
- **RA05-kick-t1 — Kick:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).
- **RA05-kick-t2 — Kick:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of RA05-kick, tier 2 of 3 (rank 2, fears, charms, polymorphs, stuns and sleeps; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **RA05-kick-t3 — Kick:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of RA05-kick, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **RA05-kick — Kick:** The interrupt: 25 energy, 10 s categoryRecoveryTime, spent on a cast rather than on cooldown. A bot only interrupted the mob it had selected, so with the party on another mob nobody stopped the heal or the cast (Jammal'an's Healing Wave, the Hateforge cleric's Greater Heal).
- **RA05d-deadly-throw — Deadly Throw:** HO-TKB-PLAY-232 (rotation programme, owner order 2026-10-18): the ranged interrupt. "Deadly Throw is a ranged 3-s interrupt sharing Kick's cooldown (staff, 2025-03-30) -- use it when the caster is out of reach" (synthesis assassination-melee-dps.md L126); the pinned guide page does not name it, so this rests on the synthesis.
- **RA06-gouge — Gouge:** HO-TKB-PLAY-028 (orchestrator, levelling window): Gouge is broken by any damage (AuraInterruptFlags 2, removed on damage taken) and this rule used to fire on the ONLY target and be broken by the very next push: Vessia (Assassination, level 10, solo) Gouged at hp < 30 on her one mob and Sinister Strike followed 1-4 s later, twice (stream 20.jsonl 13:41:13 and 13:42:05). HO-TKB-PLAY-029 (orchestrator, vocabulary v10): the archive uses it on a SECOND mob ("If a second mob joins, Gouge one and kill the other", "If both are on you, Gouge one, then Evasion"), and `target: other_engaged` now aims it there: the nearest living hostile attacking the rogue that is not the kill target, read through its own health, auras and melee reach.
- **RA02f-flourish — Flourish:** HO-TKB-PLAY-260 (leveller pass, brackets 40-59): Flourish (45604, trainer level 42, 20 energy, 40 s cooldown, stances 0, a finisher: +20% parry for 8 s at one combo point to 16 s at five, aura 45604 on the rogue; `doc research/db-queries/tkbplay-260.result.txt`).
- **RA08-envenom — Envenom:** Turtle content and the spec's own finisher: an Assassination talent (141) at 30, 20 energy, 8 s at zero combo points and 28 at five, and its two aura effects are spell modifiers rather than damage, so it buffs the poisons the rest of this build exists to apply.
- **RA07-slice-and-dice — Slice and Dice:** `combo_on_target` carries the archive's other warning about the same resource -- "Do not apply a combo-point builder to an add; it wipes the boss's combo points (combo points persist per target since CC2, but only within a single target's pool)".
- **RA10k-kidney-shot-runner — Kidney Shot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-095 (orchestrator rank 3, round 106): Kidney Shot (spell 408, level 30, 20 energy, a combo-point stun finisher on a 20 s cooldown) ALONE, on a fleeing mob or an elite with three or more combo points: the guide calls it the stun finisher for dangerous mobs (rogue/leveling.md L95, L167, L184). The second attacker cannot be the target (the combo points are on the main target; `target: other_engaged` would aim a finisher at a mob with none), so the rule is the runner and the elite.
- **RA10-eviscerate — Eviscerate:** The starting-kit finisher: 30 energy, direct damage, no duration to lose, which is why it is the one finisher gated on the target being nearly dead rather than on an aura. The archive''s 60-level rows say 5 here; the format has no level_max, so the early rule applies at every level (OQ-2599 asks for a level predicate).
- **RA10a-cheap-shot — Cheap Shot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-134 (orchestrator, round 123 rogue read: 37 of 67 L25+ deaths followed a Vanish, a median 10 s later, 6 of them reopened by Cheap Shot or Ambush at low health): a stealth opener waits for 50 per cent health, so a Vanished rogue does not reopen the fight it fled. HO-TKB-PLAY-011 (decision 62, ROG-05): the solo opener from Stealth, placed directly above the first builder.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **RA00w-dissolvent-ii-main:** The guide's Deadly V and Corrosive II are AQ20 items and are not built; Deadly and Corrosive on bosses is contested for Combat Envenom in the guide and is not built either.
- **RA00x-dissolvent-ii-off:** The guide's Deadly V and Corrosive II are AQ20 items and are not built; Deadly and Corrosive on bosses is contested for Combat Envenom in the guide and is not built either.
- **RA04-cold-blood:** The Noxious Assault/Seal Fate branch is not built: no term says a Seal Fate crit is coming.
- **RA02f-flourish:** NOT built: "Whirlwind-style attacks" (no term for a mob's area attack) and the tank-niche "overlap Ghostly Strike with Flourish" (L187: a rogue is not a dungeon tank in our population).
- **RA10-eviscerate:** The archive's combat playbook gives Eviscerate the condition "5 combo points, target will die before Rupture pays off or target is bleed-immune" -- Rupture is not in this file, so Eviscerate is the spec's only dump and the second clause is always satisfied.
- **RA11g-ghostly-strike:** "Hits hard" has no term, so it is used on its cooldown like RC11 (an OPEN QUESTION in the handoff).
